name: Back to the Flames
description:
Those holding their homeland fast have found themselves encircled, but the city has its own ways when it comes to handling enemies.
<Tattered Pillar> Can be knocked down by neighboring Operators, dealing True damage to the two tiles it falls on and forming rubble that blocks routes.
